pk-metal rollout: see the rollouts, approve one, or abort it

usage: pk-metal rollout list | approve [--yes] <rollout> | abort [--yes] <rollout>

flags:
  -context string
    	kubeconfig context to use (default: the current context)
  -kubeconfig string
    	kubeconfig file
  -yes
    	do not ask (for scripts)
